slides.title: Stop Waiting to Feel 100% Ready
slides.subtitle: The spec is a wish list - not a checklist

bullets: Cyber job specs list everything they'd love, not what you need
Hiring managers expect to train the right person
Apply at 70% fit - close the gaps on the job
Confidence wins more offers than a longer cert list

caption: Most cyber candidates talk themselves out of applying before they even start. The spec is a wish list - not a requirement. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobsearch #cypherjobs #infosec
